verdict.rationale: AgentMail's first-party docs describe registering a URL to receive POST requests as soon as an event happens, as an alternative to polling. The multi-tenancy docs also describe routing webhook events per pod, which shows these are programmatic outbound HTTP callbacks. missing for 10: a documented catalog of subscribable event types, delivery details such as retries and signature verification, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: you can register a URL, and we will send you a `POST` request with the details as soon as an event happens.
Instead of constantly asking the AgentMail API if there's a new email (a process called polling), you can register a URL, and we will send you a POST request
create a `Pod` per customer, give them a scoped API key, and route webhook events to the right place.
AgentMail gives each bot a real inbox with its own address, threading, inbound webhooks, and reply-to-message.
